item.title: US expands Iran sanctions, targets rail, automotive and metals industries
item.description:
The US State Department announced on Thursday additional sanctions against networks operating in Iran's railway, automotive, and metals industries as part of Operation Economic Outcast. The measures target networks in the Middle East, East Asia, and Europe accused of helping Iran circumvent existing sanctions and maintain access to international markets.
The US Treasury Department also expanded its sector-based sanctions designations to include Iran's automotive and railway industries, allowing Washington to take action against entities operating in those sectors. According to the State Department, the measures are part of a broader effort to restrict resources that Iran could use to support terrorism, threaten regional stability, and pursue its military objectives.
The State Department accused Iran's leadership of exploiting state-owned railway companies, automobile manufacturers, and metals producers to sustain its activities. It added that the US is cooperating with other countries to block Iranian sources of illicit revenue and raise awareness among governments and businesses worldwide about the risks associated with commercial dealings with Iran.

item.description: Saudi Interior Ministry says both hero captain and terrorist co-pilot were transferred to the UAE after their conditions improved.

item.title: 'Hamas murdered my husband & son:' Bereaved mother confronts Naza creators
item.description: Sabine Taasa disrupted the European premiere of “Naza" in the Netherlands, confronting the filmmakers over their portrayal of the war. Audience members responded: “We don’t care."

item.title: Trump: It took one night to get rid of Iranian nuclear threat
item.description:
US President Donald Trump took to Truth Social to claim it only took one night to destroy Iran's nuclear program.
"I stated, numerous times, that it would take 4-6 weeks to get rid of THE IRAN NUCLEAR THREAT, and I did it in one night! The rest of the time is just to make sure it stays that way," he wrote.

item.title: CNN report: Kushner’s firm holds stake in Israeli investor in IDF suppliers
item.description: CNN says Kushner’s firm owns 7.4% of Phoenix Financial, which holds shares in IDF suppliers; the report found no evidence his diplomacy shaped its investments.

item.title: Ben-Gvir ordered to remove campaign video of him with senior Hamas terrorist
item.description:
Central Elections Committee Chairman Justice Noam Sohlberg accepted a petition filed by the Public Committee Against Torture and ordered Otzma Yehudit chairman and Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir to remove a video showing him meeting with senior Hamas official Hassan Salameh.
Sohlberg also ordered Otzma Yehudit to pay legal expenses.
Ben-Gvir responded: "Justice Sohlberg's decision against me is extremely puzzling. Terrorists in prisons must be dealt with firmly."

item.title: Smotrich instructs funding of repatriation flights for Israelis stranded in Dubai
item.description:
Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has instructed that immediate funding be allocated to the Transportation Ministry for repatriation flights to bring back Israelis stranded in Dubai and countries in the East, including India and Thailand, following the suspension of Flydubai flights.
According to Finance Ministry estimates, approximately 10,000 Israelis are awaiting flights back to Israel. Ministry officials are currently making the necessary arrangements to implement the directive.

item.title: IDF troops fire at terrorists who threw rocks at Israelis
item.description:
The IDF stated that troops dispatched to the outskirts of the village of Yasuf in Samaria following reports of rocks being thrown at Israeli civilians carried out suspect apprehension procedures, including opening fire at terrorists. Hits were identified.
An Israeli civilian was injured in the incident and evacuated for medical treatment. IDF troops and security forces are continuing operations to locate the rock-throwers and additional suspects who were at the scene.

item.title: UK-Iranian dual citizen arrested in connection with attack on base
item.description: A British citizen who also holds Iranian citizenship was arrested on suspicion of planning a terrorist act against the RAF Fairford base in Britain, which was foiled earlier this week.

item.title: Trump: From what I'm hearing, Flydubai hijacker linked to Iran
item.description: Asked if the co-pilot who attempted to hijack and crash a Flydubai flight full of Israelis was linked to Iran, President Donald Trump said: "I would say the answer based on what I'm hearing is yes, but we're working on it now."

item.title: Finance Ministry issues order to reduce excise tax on gasoline by 50 agorot
item.description:
The Finance Ministry has published a draft order for public comment that would reduce the excise tax on gasoline by 50 agorot for one month. The public comment period is expected to end this coming Sunday.
Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich is then expected to sign the order, subject to a review of the comments submitted. Once the minister signs the order, it will take effect, and gasoline prices at gas stations will be updated at midnight between Sunday and Monday.

item.title: Stabbed Flydubai hero stable after transfer From Saudi Arabia
item.description: Captain Smit Machchhar is stable after being transferred from Saudi Arabia to Abu Dhabi for further care, India’s ambassador to the UAE said.

item.title: IDF reveals: 170 terrorists killed in Gaza were presented as journalists
item.description: The IDF publishes names and evidence identifying 170 Gazans portrayed as journalists who were also operatives in terrorist organizations, including Hamas and Islamic Jihad.

item.title: From Gaza tunnels to the Sukkah: Bar Kuperstein recounts miracles & faith in captivity
item.description: Exactly one year after his release from Hamas captivity, Bar Kuperstein visited the sukkah of MK Yaakov Asher with his parents and spoke about the faith he discovered in the tunnels.

item.title: Lapid turns down invite to study Torah with Netanyahu with Torah verse of his own
item.description: Netanyahu hosts security chiefs and IDF veterans for Hoshana Rabbah Torah study at the Knesset, but Lapid cries foul over a last-minute invitation.

item.title: New record for Jewish visits to Temple Mount during Sukkot
item.description: During the intermediate days of the holiday, 8,690 Jews ascended the Temple Mount. Rabbi Elisha Wolfson, head of the Temple Mount Yeshiva: “We are seeing redemption with our own eyes."

item.title: Arab olive harvesters injure Israeli, attempt to steal weapon
item.description: The Binyamin Regional Council says three Palestinians confronted residents near Maoz Tzur, injuring a farmer and attempting to seize his weapon.

item.title: Netanyahu to flight heroes: 'You will light a torch on Independence Day'
item.description: Prime Minister meets four of the heroes of the flight from Dubai and announces that they will light a torch honoring civilian heroism on Independence Day.

item.title: Iran summons British ambassador over RAF Fairford allegations
item.description:
Iran summoned the British ambassador in Tehran for questioning over what it described as "allegations" concerning its involvement in an attempted attack on RAF Fairford in the United Kingdom, Reuters reported.
Iran has denied any involvement in the incident in recent days.

item.title: Device tied to Hamas flag near Talmon found to be dummy explosive
item.description:
Police announced that following an examination of the suspicious object bearing a Hamas flag near the community of Talmon, it was determined to be a dummy explosive device.
Route 463 has reopened to traffic in both directions.

item.title: Netanyahu to host defense chiefs in Knesset sukkah for Torah study session
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will host senior defense establishment officials today in the Knesset sukkah for a Torah study session marking Hoshana Rabbah.
Opposition Leader Yair Lapid has also been invited to the event.

item.title: Gaza Division Commander: 'We control 63% of Gaza, Hamas is in very serious condition'
item.description: Brig. Gen. Liron Betito presents the operational situation in Gaza and the extensive damage inflicted on Hamas' leadership, alongside optimism over the return of residents to Gaza border communities.

item.title: IDF exposes Hamas terrorists who were presented as innocent journalists
item.description: IDF identifies ten Gaza terrorists who were portrayed as journalists killed during the war, including operatives who infiltrated Israel on October 7. Additional cases to be revealed.

item.title: IDF eliminates terrorist who took part in abduction of six Israelis from Be'eri
item.description: Hamas terrorist Muhammad Abu Al-Shaar eliminated in Gaza City. Islamic Jihad commander who infiltrated Israel on October 7 also eliminated.

item.title: Report: Pilot stabbed on Flydubai flight flown to Dubai for further treatment
item.description: According to Indian media reports, Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar, who was stabbed by the Omani copilot aboard the Flydubai flight, was flown from Saudi Arabia to Dubai for further medical treatment.

item.title: 'They won't defeat us': Hundreds pray at spring where Netanel Shakron was murdered
item.description: A week and a half after Netanel Shakron was murdered in front of his son, hundreds arrive at the spring for morning service and Hallel prayer.

item.title: Supreme Court's recommendation to Balad leader: Quit
item.description: An expanded panel of nine justices considers the Central Elections Committee’s decision to disqualify Arab parties and two MKs from running in the next Knesset election.

item.title: Trump: 'I don't think Netanyahu was warned in advance'
item.description: US President addresses reports of advance warnings before the October 7 massacre in an interview with TIME, rejects claims that Netanyahu knew beforehand.
